    public static final int MAX = (int)4e5 + 10;
    public static long[] factorial;
    public static long[] invFactorial;

    public static void precompute() {
        factorial = new long[MAX];
        invFactorial = new long[MAX];
        factorial[0] = factorial[1] = invFactorial[0] = invFactorial[1] = 1;
        for (int i = 2; i < MAX; i++) {

        }
    }

    public static long nCr(int n, int r) {
        long res = factorial[n];
        res = (res * invFactorial[r]) % MOD;
        res = (res * invFactorial[n - r]) % MOD;
        return res;
    }

    public static long modPow(long base, long exp) {
        long result = 1L;
        base %= MOD;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) {
                result = (result * base) % MOD;
            }
            base = (base * base) % MOD;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return result;
    }

    public static void solve() {

        int n = sc.nextInt();
        long k = sc.nextLong();
        if (k == 0) {
            System.out.println(factorial[n]);
            return;
        }
        if (n <= k) {
            System.out.println(0);
            return;
        }
        long comb = nCr(n, (int)k);
        int cols = n - (int)k;
        long sum = 0;

            } else {
                sum = (sum + term) % MOD;
            }
        }
        long ans = (comb * sum) % MOD;
        ans = (2 * ans) % MOD;
        System.out.println(ans);
    }

    public static long extendedGCD(long a, long b, long[] xy) {
        if (a == 0) {
            xy[0] = 0;
            xy[1] = 1;
            return b;
        }
        long[] nextXY = new long[2];
        long gcd = extendedGCD(b % a, a, nextXY);
        xy[0] = nextXY[1] - (b / a) * nextXY[0];
        xy[1] = nextXY[0];
        return gcd;
    }

    public static long modInverse(long a, long m) {

        long gcd = extendedGCD(a, m, xy);
        if (gcd != 1) return -1;
        long inv = (xy[0] % m + m) % m;
        return inv;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        solve();
    }
